scope: Isolated SQLite/FastAPI integration; response-loss retry regression
before: Same scenario creation request with same Idempotency-Key returned distinct scenario IDs
after: 18 cases covered: 15 passed in the full-file check; the three newly added concurrency tests then passed with the manual-retry case (4 passed, 14 deselected in 9.48 seconds) after correcting test multipart size limits. Full release suite is run independently.
checks: Same key and request yields one entity and one audit event
Changed body, source identity or If-Match with same key yields idempotency_conflict 409
Dataset commit replay preserves immutable result after later draft editing
Scenario clone and frozen revision replay preserve original result after source editing
Actual evaluated comparison plan saves exactly one scenario
Update correction and application preserve lineage without duplicate branches
Import commit key is bound to its source import
Upload key includes sanitized filename, MIME type, size and content hash; repeated uploads write one object
Forced simultaneous same-key requests write one object and recover the winner after a 409
Different-key and unkeyed simultaneous uploads append to refreshed locked metadata; combined size quota rejects before storage
Export regeneration replays the same completed artifact and job
Member creation replay returns one public member without password hash or salt
Manual retry replay preserves current status, fencing attempt and retry generation
existing_boundary: Uses the existing workspace-scoped idempotency registry and database uniqueness constraint; no schema migration
